english.title: Cause / permit a group of more than 1000 small balloons to be released in contravention of article 93
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused or permitted a group of small balloons of more than 1,000 in number to be simultaneously released at a single site at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) wholly or partly within the aerodrome traffic zone of a notified aerodrome, namely **(..SPECIFY AERODROME..), during the notified operating hours of that aerodrome when you had not given to the CAA at least 28 days previous notice in writing of the release
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 93(1)(a) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
